title: Human Intelligence Platform — Digital Twin Maturity Contract
purpose: Assess whether a Personal or Enterprise Digital Twin is a profile, a synchronized model, a decision-support system or a validated human-governed closed loop.
important_distinction: The first levels describe representations that may not yet qualify as a full Digital Twin. A Digital Twin claim requires a defined entity, state, update mechanism, context, evidence and use-case outcome.

maturity_levels.name: Concept or Profile
maturity_levels.description: Static concept, profile database, directory or manually maintained record.
maturity_levels.prohibited_claim: Do not claim a functional Digital Twin.

maturity_levels.name: Structured Digital Representation
maturity_levels.description: Structured representation with an explicit state model, domain vocabulary, ownership and access rules.
maturity_levels.prohibited_claim: Do not claim synchronization, prediction or operational feedback without evidence.

maturity_levels.name: Event-Linked or Observed Twin
maturity_levels.description: The representation updates from identified events or observations with provenance and timestamps.
maturity_levels.boundary: One-way observation or event ingestion may still be called a digital shadow in some taxonomies.

maturity_levels.name: Contextual Human-in-the-Loop Twin
maturity_levels.description: The twin interprets state in context, evaluates goals and supports a documented human decision or action.
maturity_levels.product_relevance: Minimum target for the Human Intelligence Platform thesis.

maturity_levels.name: Predictive or Scenario Twin
maturity_levels.description: The twin forecasts possible future states or compares what-if scenarios using validated models.
maturity_levels.prohibited_claim: Prediction quality cannot be inferred from a model merely existing.

maturity_levels.name: Prescriptive or Closed-Loop Twin
maturity_levels.description: The twin recommends or initiates authorized actions, measures outcomes and updates itself through feedback.
maturity_levels.boundary: Autonomous action is never implied by maturity alone; authority must be explicitly governed.

maturity_levels.name: Federated System of Twins
maturity_levels.description: Multiple twins interoperate through explicit contracts, synchronized relationships and governed cross-twin workflows.
maturity_levels.product_relevance: Long-term target for Personal Digital Twin, Enterprise Digital Twin and relationship workflows.

assessment_rules: A twin is assessed per use case, not only per platform brand.
The highest claimed level is capped by the weakest required capability or missing evidence.
A static profile cannot be promoted to a twin by renaming it.
Synchronization frequency and fidelity must be defined for the use case; real-time is not universally required.
Personal, enterprise and asset twins may have different update frequencies, evidence standards and access policies.
Maturity level does not replace security, privacy, validation or regulatory review.
Every promotion requires an evidence record and a decision owner.

current_project_assessment.current_evidence_gap: No production source code or executed event-to-state experiment is currently present in the repository.
